name: John Deere Kernersville (Deere-Hitachi Construction) - Kernersville NC

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in 2026-03 Street View on John Deere Rd: a controlled truck entrance to the Main Campus - chain-link perimeter fence with sliding gate sections across the drive, entrance lane pinch-point. The East Campus has its own gated access on a separate internal/access road; truckGateCount set to 2.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed: a white guard booth (~1-vehicle footprint) sits beside the Main Campus entrance lane, clearly visible in 2026-03 Street View and z19 satellite. Staffed checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved/yard areas inside the gate before the dock banks can hold queuing trucks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long access drives from John Deere Rd into the campus and between the Main and East campuses - can stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50: dock banks on the Main Campus and the East Campus W face show continuous dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in. Counted ~30; some building faces obscured by construction.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+: extensive trailer parking and staging across both campuses - z19 imagery shows dozens of trailers in rows, plus large finished-excavator staging yards. High-volume drop operation.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters - Main Campus (plate/weld/machine/paint) and East Campus (assembly/logistics) are distinct.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with two large building clusters - Main Campus and East Campus across 145 acres, connected by internal roads. A new 380,000 sq ft excavator factory was under construction at audit time (visible earthwork/construction).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The facility sits on the rural edge of Kernersville surrounded by woods and farmland (John Deere Rd is a rural two-lane road). Per the rubric's edge-of-town/farmland guidance, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line passes the SW edge of the property; no active spur observed entering either campus - railServed false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Web sources cite 145 acres across the Main and East campuses; used directly. The perimeter bounding box is larger because the two campuses are separated.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Main Campus gate confirmed via Street View; East Campus has its own access - estimated 2 truck gates total (East gate not directly Street-View confirmed).
fieldNotes.fieldNote_construction: Active construction at audit time - the $70M / 380,000 sq ft small-excavator factory expansion. Some yard geometry will change once complete.

citations.claim: $70M Kernersville NC excavator factory assuming production of future-generation excavators previously made in Japan; solely John Deere.
Hitachi Construction Machinery confirms the Deere JV dissolved Feb 28 2022; Deere acquired the Kernersville NC factory and continues making Deere-branded excavators there.

verification.rationale: Deere-Hitachi JV dissolved Feb 2022; Deere ACQUIRED and now solely operates Kernersville, investing $70M to expand excavator production. Not closed/transferred.
